notice: Every record, name, file, and result in this demo is SYNTHETIC.

runs.title: Synthetic baseline comparison
runs.summary: This synthetic package starts with two evidence files for a human review. The live evidence check shows whether those files remain present and unchanged.

runs.title: Synthetic replication package
runs.summary: A deliberately missing report demonstrates the approval gate. The manifest names evidence that is not present.

runs.title: Synthetic revised results
runs.summary: A deliberately changed file demonstrates tamper detection. Its current contents differ from the recorded hash.

runs.title: Synthetic proposal without evidence
runs.summary: An empty evidence package cannot be approved. A reviewer can assign an owner or request supporting files.

runs.title: Synthetic methods clarification
runs.summary: This synthetic package starts with one methods file. A reviewer must judge whether the comparison is adequately explained and inspect the live evidence check.
